reply_text:
I've answered Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is **#8841**, though the link to Marrow Fieldworks is my inference and not confirmed.

- **Where it comes from:** Tobias wrote in #central-random on 13 Oct at 9:27 that West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk. He said he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841.
- **What's not confirmed:** Tobias said it was on "his dealer account" and didn't name it. I read that as Marrow Fieldworks because the Central handoff digest from 2 January says Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan 2026. The digest doesn't say who took it over, so I suggested Pree check with Tobias before her customer call.
- **Other tickets:** I told her that #4409 and #4412 from the same digest are older Fieldworks tickets about other problems, so they aren't this one.

I only used what Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team and public files. A ticket number isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to post in the channel.
